title: Translucent Material Laboratory
description: The user operates a virtual material science workbench where a translucent plant sits inside a diffuse transmission teacup acting as a specimen container. Through a series of interactive controls, the user adjusts subsurface scattering, transmission intensity, color tinting, thickness mapping, roughness, and lighting angle to match a target material profile displayed as a reference swatch.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Translucent Material Laboratory. Load both DiffuseTransmissionPlant.glb and DiffuseTransmissionTeacup.glb using GLTFLoader. Place the teacup at the center of the scene and position the plant model so it appears to be growing out of or sitting inside the teacup, scaled appropriately. Apply MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission and thickness properties to both models. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 2, 5) looking at the origin, with OrbitControls for rotation only (disable pan and zoom). Add one DirectionalLight and one warm-toned PointLight that the user can reposition. Create an HTML overlay panel on the right side with these interactive controls: (1) a slider for transmission intensity (0 to 1, default 0.5) applied to both models, (2) a color picker for transmission attenuation color applied to the teacup, (3) a slider for thickness (0 to 5, default 1) on the plant, (4) a slider for roughness (0 to 1, default 0.3) on both models, (5) a slider for ior (1.0 to 2.5, default 1.5) on the teacup, (6) a vertical slider controlling the DirectionalLight polar angle (0 to 180 degrees) to sweep light from above to below, (7) a toggle button that switches the scene background between a dark environment (0x111111) and a bright environment (0xeeeeee) to demonstrate how transmission appearance changes with background. Display a small target reference box in the top-left corner showing the goal values: transmission 0.85, attenuationColor #44cc88, thickness 3.2, roughness 0.15, ior 1.8, light angle 120 degrees, bright background. Add a Validate button that checks all seven parameters against the target within tolerances of 0.08 for floats, 15 degrees for angle, 30 units per RGB channel for color, and correct background. Show a success banner with a green glow effect when all parameters match. Use a neutral HDR-less environment; set renderer toneMapping to ACESFilmicToneMapping and outputColorSpace to SRGBColorSpace. Render at full viewport size with antialiasing enabled.
